name: sehhati
description: Free web app to check bread and flour ingredients for potassium bromate (E924)

paragraphs: A free, mobile-first web app that helps consumers check bread and flour ingredient lists for potassium bromate (E924) and other flagged dough improvers, and guides them through lab testing and filing a complaint with the competent authority.

Potassium bromate is a flour improver classified by IARC as Group 2B (possibly carcinogenic to humans) and banned in many countries. In many markets, bread is sold without an ingredient label, and consumers have no simple way to check. Sehhati turns that into a one-minute check and a clear next step.
features: Ingredient scan: paste an ingredient list; the app detects potassium bromate under its different names and codes (Arabic and English, E924 / E924b), plus azodicarbonamide (E927a) and potassium iodate (E917) as extra…
Barcode lookup: type or scan a barcode (camera, on supported browsers); ingredients are fetched from Open Food Facts and checked.
Flour and bakery registry: searchable results of documented lab analyses (data.json).
Complaint generator: builds a ready-to-send complaint letter (copy or share via WhatsApp). Nothing is stored or sent by the app.
Guide: questions to ask the bakery, how to take a sample for lab analysis, and buying tips.
